findings.text: follow-on: the committed receipt records report.status 'already-marked' for docs/figures/figure-and-solver-audit/low-state-amplitude-nan/report.md, but the reviewed commit is the change that introduces that marker: the base revision 84ead4bc grep count for 'dimensions_provenance' in that report is 0 and at head it is 1. The receipt field therefore misreports the report marker as pre-existing when this run added it, and a driver run over the true base cannot produce a receipt with both twenty JSON blocks and 'already-marked' for the report. The marker content itself is correct and byte-identical to the driver's format, so the defect is in the recorded provenance, not in the artifact.

follow-on: the idempotency is observable in the wrong direction. Because provenance_paths appends a path only when the block is newly created, a re-run over an already-marked tree writes a receipt with empty provenance_paths and prints ANNOTATED 0 for every file, indistinguishable at a glance from a run that marked nothing. The cited test log is exactly such a re-run (blocks: 0, marked files this node: 0), so re-running the driver to 'verify' cannot confirm a prior mark and cannot substitute for it; a receipt intended as proof of a mark should record the count of blocks PRESENT, not only newly added.

gate_arms_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own suites. The reviewed run carries no baseline_suite and no after_suite key: it is a documentation change under docs/figures/ that touches no module and no test, and its manifest declares negative_control none. The added-failure count is therefore 0 and the id set empty by ABSENCE OF ANY CODE ARM, not by a measured before/after identity. The log it cites (annotation-gate.log) is a driver+verify check of the annotation, not a pytest suite, and does not carry a baseline/after pair. This review did not re-run any suite because neither arm was declared and there is no source change to gate.

justifications.durability: The marker is a durable, machine-readable block written into the committed artifact beside the value it annotates, so a reader of the receipt sees the retirement without leaving the file, and the record is re-runnable (the driver is idempotent and preserves an existing block). Held below full for two reasons. There is no guard that a later edit cannot silently drop the marker, and no negative control falsifies the marker's presence (the node declared negative_control none: no test file in the write paths). And the idempotency itself is what produced the cited log's all-zero reading: provenance_paths records only blocks this invocation added, so a re-run reports zero blocks and zero marked files, which reads as 'nothing marked' instead of 'already marked'.
justifications.evidence: The substance is independently reproducible: a path-keyed numeric diff between base and head over all twelve changed receipt JSONs is empty (0 changed, 0 missing value paths), the provenance arithmetic checks out (swept 3840/3072/2816 = atomic_support_capacity x 128; current 158/152/150 = 128 + straight, matching _SPLINE_BOUNDARY_SEGMENTS=128 in nova/equilibrium/separatrix_clip.py:54,78; historical quadrature (cap-2)*64 matches each recorded value), the retiring revision f7fefbd7 exists and reads 'size the traced polygon capacity to its realised capacity', and the whole-tree sweep reproduces (33 targets at the recorded snapshot; 34/19/15 now that the receipt itself is a tracked artifact). But the FURNISHED evidence does not reconcile: the cited test_log annotation-gate.log is an idempotent re-run over an already-marked tree (driver prints ANNOTATED 0 for every file, verify prints blocks: 0 and marked files this node: 0, report already-marked), so it cannot evidence the twenty blocks the manifest quotes from it; the manifest's tests field quotes 'blocks 20' as this log's summary while the log's own summary reads blocks: 0. The commit body and manifest also state 'the tracked diff is 399 insertions, 0 deletions' where git reports 16 files changed, 855 insertions (399 is the annotated-receipt/report subset only).
justifications.fit: The change sits in the docs/figures receipt tree it maintains, reuses the provenance form already committed under docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/reposed-fixture/certificate/solve-memory-identification.json (named in the manifest's evidence_inputs), and ships a small focused driver. No plan, sprint or ticket identifier appears in any filename, symbol or comment; the driver docstring states the mechanism (the traced layout as spline_chain_samples_per_chord plus atomic_support_capacity) and the retiring revision solely as provenance data. No abstraction is added beyond the one helper.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The change marks the swept exact_support_capacity historical exactly where the goal names: twenty dimensions_provenance blocks across the two exact-clip-capacity receipts and the ten scan-prototype parts, plus a spliced block in the fenced receipt quoted in the low-state-amplitude report. Each block names the value historical, quotes the superseded swept expression, names the retiring revision f7fefbd7, and states the current derived value. Records are left numerically intact and the whole-tree sweep identifies the fifteen remaining unmarked target files under cut-cell-current-attribution as follow-ons. Held below full because the committed receipt's own report field is inconsistent with the change (below).
justifications.scope_discipline: The landed diff is sixteen files, every one inside a declared write path: docs/figures/exact-clip-capacity/{memory-base,memory-current}.json, the ten docs/figures/millisecond-converged-solve/scan-prototype/parts/*.json, the low-state-amplitude-nan report block, the docs/evidence fragment, and the new driver plus its receipt under docs/figures/exact-clip-moment-quadrature/ecq-mark-swept-capacity-receipts/. No source module and no test file is touched, so there is no code surface to regress. The fifteen unmarked swept files under docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/ are correctly returned as follow_ons rather than edited, and the manifest names them explicitly.

notes: The reviewed node is a documentation-provenance change with no code arm: it marks the swept exact_support_capacity historical in the clip and scan receipts and leaves every recorded number intact. The substance is sound and independently verified (empty numeric diff, correct arithmetic, valid revision anchor, reproducible sweep). Two evidence defects keep the score below full. (1) The cited gate log annotation-gate.log is an idempotent re-run over an already-marked tree and shows blocks: 0 / marked files this node: 0, so it does not evidence the twenty blocks the manifest quotes from it; the manifest's 'blocks 20' does not reconcile with its own tests log. (2) The committed receipt records report.status 'already-marked' although this commit is what adds that report marker (base 0 -> head 0, 1 occurrences). Three further imprecisions: the '399 insertions' headline understates the commit's 855; the report splice was not produced by the driver's own report branch (which would have returned 'marked'); and provenance_paths counts only newly-added blocks, so a re-run reads as marking nothing. None of these changes a recorded numeric value or lands outside the declared scope. Scores: goal_fidelity 18, evidence 13, scope_discipline 20, durability 15, fit 19.
